evidence_items.finding: owner reports blended gross margin of 38% but describes commercial installation contracts at 18% and residential service calls at 60%
evidence_items.rationale: Reported blended margin inconsistent with described service-line margins is a critical adverse data quality signal. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: commercial installations represent approximately 70% of revenue but carry a significantly lower margin than residential service calls
evidence_items.rationale: High-volume low-margin service line dominating revenue is a critical adverse mix signal. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: no service-line profit and loss has been prepared in two years
evidence_items.rationale: Absence of service-line financial reporting for two years is a critical adverse process maturity signal. process_maturity; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: owner attributes margin pressure to materials costs rising without having isolated which service line is generating the pressure
evidence_items.rationale: Attributing margin decline to input costs without service-line data is an adverse diagnostic evidence signal. process_maturity.

evidence_items.finding: plumbing and gas; $1.1M revenue; 38% blended margin (stated); commercial 70% of revenue at ~18%; residential ~30% at ~60%; no service-line P&L for 2 years
Surface signal (not root cause): rising materials costs in the sector provide a plausible external explanation for margin pressure
evidence_items.rationale: Industry materials cost increases are a misleading external signal when the service-line margin data needed to confirm the attribution is absent.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): a blended margin of 38% does not appear alarming in isolation for a plumbing business
evidence_items.rationale: An acceptable blended margin figure is a misleading adequacy signal when the underlying service-line data may not support that number.

metric_key_mappings.transform_note: Implied blended margin from service-line data: 70%×18% + 30%×60% = 30.6%, not 38%

validation_notes: SIM-13-005 is SUPPORTED via margin_erosion. Service-line mix driving blended margin below reported figure maps to margin erosion. No must_identify vocabulary.
